name: smwgraphics-resplendent-ghost-house
title: Resplendent Ghost House
description:
A big set of ghost house graphics, including an FG, several variations on a BG, and two layer 3 BGs. The FG features an animated clock. The BG features animated lights. The set is intended to mix and/or match conveniently and includes enough graphics for some kinds of castle.

To use the layer 3 BGs you will want some kind of patch to either make the status bar work properly with layer 3 on subscreen or remove it.
